newsitem.title: THAILAND: Jutha Maritime ill-fated ship insured.
newsitem.headline: Jutha Maritime ill-fated ship insured.

text.p: Jutha Maritime Plc said on Friday it had taken out a 50 million baht accident insurance policy on its freighter Jutha Jessica which sank in South Korean waters on New Year's day.
A Jutha official said the Jutha Jessica, carrying 2,000 tonnes of steel from Japan, broke in two on Wednesday after it hit a rock in heavy seas off the South Korean Port of Pusan.
Five Thai crew members were reported missing.
The company said in a statement to the Stock Exchange of Thailand that the ship, one of its 11 vessels, was insured with the South East Insurance Ltd.
Jutha Maritime is Thailand's largest shipping company operating between Thailand, Japan, South Korea and Borneo.
